items.question: Trong câu "Most software development work in the world is NOT building new systems from scratch — it is modifying, extending, or replacing systems that already exist.", từ "modify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most software development work in the world is NOT building new systems from scratch — it is modifying, extending, or replacing systems that already exist.", what does "modify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: modify /ˈmɒdɪfaɪ/ (động từ): sửa đổi, điều chỉnh. "Modify a system" = sửa đổi một hệ thống đang có, khác với xây mới "from scratch".
items.explanationEn: modify /ˈmɒdɪfaɪ/ (verb): to change something partly. "Modify a system" means changing an existing one, as opposed to building "from scratch".

items.question: Trong câu "The original requirements document — if it ever existed — went stale long ago.", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The original requirements document — if it ever existed — went stale long ago.", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: out of date, no longer accurate
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): lỗi thời, không còn đúng. "Go stale" = trở nên lỗi thời; tài liệu không được cập nhật sẽ nhanh chóng "stale".
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): out of date, no longer accurate. "Go stale" means to become outdated; documents that are not maintained quickly go stale.

items.question: Trong câu "The existing system is both a constraint and a source of information.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The existing system is both a constraint and a source of information.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. "Constraint" = điều giới hạn lựa chọn của bạn; hay gặp trong "technical constraint".
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limitation or restriction. A constraint limits your choices; common in "technical constraint" or "time constraint".

items.question: Trong câu "An old system contains countless rules, exceptions, and special-case handling added over the years that nobody remembers the reason for.", từ "countless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An old system contains countless rules, exceptions, and special-case handling added over the years that nobody remembers the reason for.", what does "countless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: countless /ˈkaʊntləs/ (tính từ): vô số, rất nhiều. "Countless" = nhiều đến mức không đếm xuể; thường đi trước danh từ số nhiều.
items.explanationEn: countless /ˈkaʊntləs/ (adjective): too many to count. "Countless" means too many to count; it usually comes before a plural noun.

items.question: Trong câu "Users often refuse to lose any functionality, including functionality they do not actually use.", từ "refuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users often refuse to lose any functionality, including functionality they do not actually use.", what does "refuse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to say you will not do something
items.explanation: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (động từ): từ chối, không chịu. "Refuse to do something" = không chịu làm gì; danh từ là "refusal".
items.explanationEn: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (verb): to say you will not do something. "Refuse to do something" means to be unwilling to do it; the noun is "refusal".

items.question: Trong câu "The new system may have to run in parallel, or the cutover must happen in a short window without losing data.", từ "cutover" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The new system may have to run in parallel, or the cutover must happen in a short window without losing data.", what does "cutover" (noun) mean?
options: thời điểm chuyển sang hệ thống mới
optionsEn: the switch from the old system to the new
items.explanation: cutover /ˈkʌtəʊvə(r)/ (danh từ): thời điểm chuyển sang hệ thống mới. "Cutover" = lúc chính thức chuyển từ hệ thống cũ sang hệ thống mới; hay đi với "cutover plan".
items.explanationEn: cutover /ˈkʌtəʊvə(r)/ (noun): the switch from the old system to the new. "Cutover" is the moment you switch from the old system to the new one; often in "cutover plan".

items.question: Trong câu "You will replicate functionality nobody uses any more — studies repeatedly find a substantial share of features in enterprise systems are rarely or never used.", từ "substantial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You will replicate functionality nobody uses any more — studies repeatedly find a substantial share of features in enterprise systems are rarely or never used.", what does "substantial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: substantial /səbˈstænʃl/ (tính từ): đáng kể, lớn. "A substantial share/amount" = một phần/lượng đáng kể.
items.explanationEn: substantial /səbˈstænʃl/ (adjective): large in amount or importance. "A substantial share" or "a substantial amount" means a large, significant part.

items.question: Trong câu "You will replicate the workarounds users invented to get around the old system limitations.", từ "workaround" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You will replicate the workarounds users invented to get around the old system limitations.", what does "workaround" (noun) mean?
options: cách xoay xở tạm để né vấn đề
optionsEn: a way to get around a problem
items.explanation: workaround /ˈwɜːkəraʊnd/ (danh từ): cách xoay xở tạm để né vấn đề. "Workaround" = cách làm tạm để vượt qua giới hạn của hệ thống; khác với sửa tận gốc (fix).
items.explanationEn: workaround /ˈwɜːkəraʊnd/ (noun): a way to get around a problem. A workaround bypasses a limitation without really fixing it, unlike a proper fix.

items.question: Trong câu "The right approach: use the old system as a SOURCE OF INFORMATION, not as a BLUEPRINT.", từ "blueprint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The right approach: use the old system as a SOURCE OF INFORMATION, not as a BLUEPRINT.", what does "blueprint" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a plan or model to copy
items.explanation: blueprint /ˈbluːprɪnt/ (danh từ): khuôn mẫu để làm theo. "Blueprint" nghĩa gốc là bản vẽ kỹ thuật; nghĩa bóng là khuôn mẫu để làm theo y hệt.
items.explanationEn: blueprint /ˈbluːprɪnt/ (noun): a plan or model to copy. Literally a technical drawing; figuratively, a detailed model that others follow exactly.

items.question: Trong câu "When documentation does not exist, you must reconstruct understanding from multiple sources and cross-check them against each other.", từ "reconstruct" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When documentation does not exist, you must reconstruct understanding from multiple sources and cross-check them against each other.", what does "reconstruct" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to build up again from pieces
items.explanation: reconstruct /ˌriːkənˈstrʌkt/ (động từ): tái dựng, dựng lại. "Reconstruct" = dựng lại một thứ đã mất từ các mảnh thông tin còn lại.
items.explanationEn: reconstruct /ˌriːkənˈstrʌkt/ (verb): to build up again from pieces. "Reconstruct" means rebuilding something lost from the pieces of evidence that remain.

items.question: Trong câu "The workarounds — every workaround is an unmet requirement waiting to be found.", từ "unmet" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The workarounds — every workaround is an unmet requirement waiting to be found.", what does "unmet" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unmet /ʌnˈmet/ (tính từ): chưa được đáp ứng. "Unmet need/requirement" = nhu cầu/yêu cầu chưa được đáp ứng.
items.explanationEn: unmet /ʌnˈmet/ (adjective): not yet satisfied. An "unmet need" or "unmet requirement" is one that has not been satisfied yet.

items.question: Trong câu "The principle: every Excel spreadsheet a user maintains alongside the official system is an indictment of missing functionality.", từ "indictment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The principle: every Excel spreadsheet a user maintains alongside the official system is an indictment of missing functionality.", what does "indictment" (noun) mean?
options: bằng chứng cho thấy điều gì tồi tệ
optionsEn: a sign that something is bad
items.explanation: indictment /ɪnˈdaɪtmənt/ (danh từ): bằng chứng cho thấy điều gì tồi tệ. "An indictment of X" = bằng chứng cho thấy X có vấn đề; nghĩa pháp lý là bản cáo trạng.
items.explanationEn: indictment /ɪnˈdaɪtmənt/ (noun): a sign that something is bad. "An indictment of X" shows X is failing; in law it means a formal criminal charge.

items.question: Trong câu "Which fields are actually populated and which are always empty — always-empty fields may be unnecessary.", từ "populate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which fields are actually populated and which are always empty — always-empty fields may be unnecessary.", what does "populate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: populate /ˈpɒpjuleɪt/ (động từ): điền dữ liệu vào. Trong phần mềm, "a populated field" = trường đã có dữ liệu; nghĩa đời thường là cư ngụ.
items.explanationEn: populate /ˈpɒpjuleɪt/ (verb): to fill with data. In software a "populated field" contains data; in everyday use it means to inhabit a place.

items.question: Trong câu "Expensive and slow, but sometimes the only way to unearth a buried business rule.", từ "unearth" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Expensive and slow, but sometimes the only way to unearth a buried business rule.", what does "unearth" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: unearth /ʌnˈɜːθ/ (động từ): khám phá ra, đào ra. "Unearth" nghĩa đen là đào lên; nghĩa bóng là tìm ra điều bị che giấu lâu nay.
items.explanationEn: unearth /ʌnˈɜːθ/ (verb): to discover something hidden. Literally to dig up; figuratively, to find something that was hidden for a long time.

items.question: Trong câu "They carry tribal knowledge recorded nowhere.", từ "tribal knowledge" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They carry tribal knowledge recorded nowhere.", what does "tribal knowledge" (phrase) mean?
options: kiến thức chỉ truyền miệng trong nhóm
kiến thức về các bộ lạc
optionsEn: unwritten know-how held by a group
items.explanation: tribal knowledge /ˈtraɪbl ˈnɒlɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): kiến thức chỉ truyền miệng trong nhóm. "Tribal knowledge" = hiểu biết không được ghi chép, chỉ nằm trong đầu một nhóm người.
items.explanationEn: tribal knowledge /ˈtraɪbl ˈnɒlɪdʒ/ (phrase): unwritten know-how held by a group. "Tribal knowledge" is know-how that lives only in people's heads, not in documents.

items.question: Trong câu "A serious staffing risk: if only ONE person understands the old system and that person is about to retire, that is a top project risk.", từ "retire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A serious staffing risk: if only ONE person understands the old system and that person is about to retire, that is a top project risk.", what does "retire" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stop working because of age
items.explanation: retire /rɪˈtaɪə(r)/ (động từ): nghỉ hưu. "Be about to retire" = sắp nghỉ hưu; với hệ thống, "retire" còn có nghĩa là ngừng vận hành.
items.explanationEn: retire /rɪˈtaɪə(r)/ (verb): to stop working because of age. "About to retire" means close to leaving work for good; for systems it means taking out of service.

items.question: Trong câu "In replacement projects, data migration is routinely and seriously underestimated — and it is frequently what makes the project slip.", từ "underestimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In replacement projects, data migration is routinely and seriously underestimated — and it is frequently what makes the project slip.", what does "underestimate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to think it is bigger than it is
to think it is smaller than it is
items.explanation: underestimate /ˌʌndərˈestɪmeɪt/ (động từ): đánh giá thấp. "Underestimate" = đánh giá thấp độ khó/khối lượng; trái nghĩa là "overestimate".
items.explanationEn: underestimate /ˌʌndərˈestɪmeɪt/ (verb): to think it is smaller than it is. To underestimate is to judge something as easier or smaller than it is; opposite "overestimate".

items.question: Trong câu "In replacement projects, data migration is routinely and seriously underestimated — and it is frequently what makes the project slip.", từ "slip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In replacement projects, data migration is routinely and seriously underestimated — and it is frequently what makes the project slip.", what does "slip" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to lose your footing and fall
items.explanation: slip /slɪp/ (động từ): bị trễ tiến độ. Trong quản lý dự án, "the schedule slips" = tiến độ bị trễ; nghĩa đời thường là trượt chân.
items.explanationEn: slip /slɪp/ (verb): to fall behind schedule. In project management "a schedule slips" when it falls behind; literally, to lose your footing.

items.question: Trong câu "Orphan records referencing things that no longer exist.", từ "orphan" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Orphan records referencing things that no longer exist.", what does "orphan" (adjective) mean?
options: mồ côi, mất liên kết cha
optionsEn: with no parent it links to
items.explanation: orphan /ˈɔːfn/ (tính từ): mồ côi, mất liên kết cha. "Orphan record" = bản ghi tham chiếu tới một bản ghi cha đã bị xóa.
items.explanationEn: orphan /ˈɔːfn/ (adjective): with no parent it links to. An "orphan record" points to a parent record that no longer exists.

items.question: Trong câu "Multiple formats for the same kind of information, because conventions changed over the years.", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multiple formats for the same kind of information, because conventions changed over the years.", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an agreed usual way of doing things
items.explanation: convention /kənˈvenʃn/ (danh từ): quy ước, cách làm chung. "Naming convention" = quy ước đặt tên; "convention" còn có nghĩa là hội nghị.
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈvenʃn/ (noun): an agreed usual way of doing things. As in "naming convention"; the word can also mean a large formal conference.

items.question: Trong câu "One old field may split into three new ones, or three old fields merge into one.", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One old field may split into three new ones, or three old fields merge into one.", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (động từ): gộp lại, hợp nhất. "Merge into one" = gộp thành một; trái nghĩa với "split".
items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (verb): to combine into one. "Merge into one" means to combine; its opposite here is "split".

items.question: Trong câu "The new system may have no corresponding concept.", từ "corresponding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The new system may have no corresponding concept.", what does "corresponding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: corresponding /ˌkɒrəˈspɒndɪŋ/ (tính từ): tương ứng. "Corresponding X" = X tương ứng ở phía bên kia; động từ "correspond to".
items.explanationEn: corresponding /ˌkɒrəˈspɒndɪŋ/ (adjective): matching or equivalent. "A corresponding X" is the matching one on the other side; the verb is "correspond to".

items.question: Trong câu "Old historical data can be archived instead of migrated.", từ "archive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Old historical data can be archived instead of migrated.", what does "archive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: archive /ˈɑːkaɪv/ (động từ): lưu trữ lâu dài. "Archive data" = cất dữ liệu cũ vào kho lưu trữ, vẫn truy xuất được khi cần.
items.explanationEn: archive /ˈɑːkaɪv/ (verb): to store for long-term keeping. To archive data is to move old data into storage where it can still be retrieved.

items.question: Trong câu "You need concrete reconciliation criteria: record counts, financial totals, random sample checks.", từ "reconciliation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need concrete reconciliation criteria: record counts, financial totals, random sample checks.", what does "reconciliation" (noun) mean?
options: đối soát, so khớp số liệu
optionsEn: checking that two sets of figures match
items.explanation: reconciliation /ˌrekənsɪliˈeɪʃn/ (danh từ): đối soát, so khớp số liệu. Trong dữ liệu/kế toán, "reconciliation" = đối chiếu hai nguồn xem có khớp không.
items.explanationEn: reconciliation /ˌrekənsɪliˈeɪʃn/ (noun): checking that two sets of figures match. In data and accounting, reconciliation checks whether two sources agree; otherwise it means making peace.

items.question: Trong câu "If the cutover fails partway, how do you return to the old system without losing transactions?", từ "partway" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the cutover fails partway, how do you return to the old system without losing transactions?", what does "partway" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in the middle of the process
items.explanation: partway /ˌpɑːtˈweɪ/ (trạng từ): giữa chừng. "Fail partway (through)" = thất bại khi đang làm dở giữa chừng.
items.explanationEn: partway /ˌpɑːtˈweɪ/ (adverb): in the middle of the process. "Fail partway (through)" means to fail while the process is only partly done.

items.question: Trong câu "Run exploratory queries against the real data to learn what you are facing.", từ "exploratory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Run exploratory queries against the real data to learn what you are facing.", what does "exploratory" (adjective) mean?
options: mang tính thăm dò, khám phá
items.explanation: exploratory /ɪkˈsplɒrətri/ (tính từ): mang tính thăm dò, khám phá. "Exploratory query/testing" = truy vấn/kiểm thử để thăm dò, tìm hiểu tình hình.
items.explanationEn: exploratory /ɪkˈsplɒrətri/ (adjective): done to find out more. "Exploratory queries" or "exploratory testing" are done to discover what is there.

items.question: Trong câu "A packaged solution (COTS — commercial off-the-shelf) is commercial software bought and configured rather than developed.", từ "off-the-shelf" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A packaged solution (COTS — commercial off-the-shelf) is commercial software bought and configured rather than developed.", what does "off-the-shelf" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: off-the-shelf /ˌɒf ðə ˈʃelf/ (tính từ): có sẵn để mua ngay. "Off-the-shelf" = mua sẵn trên thị trường, trái với "custom-built" (làm riêng).
items.explanationEn: off-the-shelf /ˌɒf ðə ˈʃelf/ (adjective): ready-made and sold as is. "Off-the-shelf" products are bought ready-made, as opposed to "custom-built" ones.

items.question: Trong câu "A mature solution exists with many reference customers", từ "mature" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A mature solution exists with many reference customers", what does "mature" (adjective) mean?
options: đã phát triển ổn định, hoàn thiện
items.explanation: mature /məˈtʃʊə(r)/ (tính từ): đã phát triển ổn định, hoàn thiện. "Mature product/solution" = sản phẩm đã ổn định qua nhiều năm; với người là trưởng thành.
items.explanationEn: mature /məˈtʃʊə(r)/ (adjective): well developed and stable. A "mature product" is stable after years of use; for people it means adult or grown-up.

items.question: Trong câu "Regulatory compliance is maintained by the vendor", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Regulatory compliance is maintained by the vendor", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ (quy định). "Regulatory compliance" = tuân thủ quy định pháp luật; động từ "comply with".
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (noun): obeying rules or laws. "Regulatory compliance" means following laws and regulations; the verb is "comply with".

items.question: Trong câu "Without requirements you have no basis for choosing between packages, and you will choose based on the most impressive sales demo — which almost always leads to a poor decision.", từ "impressive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without requirements you have no basis for choosing between packages, and you will choose based on the most impressive sales demo — which almost always leads to a poor decision.", what does "impressive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: impressive /ɪmˈpresɪv/ (tính từ): gây ấn tượng mạnh. "Impressive" = gây ấn tượng; bài viết cảnh báo đừng chọn theo bản demo ấn tượng nhất.
items.explanationEn: impressive /ɪmˈpresɪv/ (adjective): making a strong impression. "Impressive" means striking; the article warns against choosing by the flashiest demo.

items.question: Trong câu "Buy the wrong thing — far worse, because it is harder to reverse", từ "reverse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Buy the wrong thing — far worse, because it is harder to reverse", what does "reverse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reverse /rɪˈvɜːs/ (động từ): đảo ngược, hủy quyết định. "Reverse a decision" = đảo ngược quyết định; nghĩa khác: lùi xe (reverse a car).
items.explanationEn: reverse /rɪˈvɜːs/ (verb): to undo or change back. "Reverse a decision" means to undo it; another sense is to drive a car backwards.

items.question: Trong câu "The most important insight about this decision: do not buy a package for what CREATES your competitive advantage.", từ "competitive advantage" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important insight about this decision: do not buy a package for what CREATES your competitive advantage.", what does "competitive advantage" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: what makes you better than rivals
items.explanation: competitive advantage /kəmˈpetətɪv ədˈvɑːntɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): lợi thế cạnh tranh. "Competitive advantage" = điều giúp doanh nghiệp vượt đối thủ; nên tự xây, không mua.
items.explanationEn: competitive advantage /kəmˈpetətɪv ədˈvɑːntɪdʒ/ (phrase): what makes you better than rivals. A competitive advantage is what sets you ahead of rivals; build it rather than buy it.

items.question: Trong câu "Define requirements at a level sufficient to discriminate.", từ "sufficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define requirements at a level sufficient to discriminate.", what does "sufficient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sufficient /səˈfɪʃnt/ (tính từ): đủ, vừa đủ. "Sufficient to do something" = đủ để làm gì; trái nghĩa "insufficient".
items.explanationEn: sufficient /səˈfɪʃnt/ (adjective): enough for the purpose. "Sufficient to do something" means enough for it; the opposite is "insufficient".

items.question: Trong câu "Classify requirements by how mandatory they are.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Classify requirements by how mandatory they are.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmændətəri/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. "Mandatory" = bắt buộc; ở đây dùng để phân loại must-have / should-have / nice-to-have.
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmændətəri/ (adjective): required, compulsory. "Mandatory" means compulsory; here it ranks must-have, should-have and nice-to-have.

items.question: Trong câu "Must-have: without it, the package is eliminated immediately.", từ "eliminate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Must-have: without it, the package is eliminated immediately.", what does "eliminate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: eliminate /ɪˈlɪmɪneɪt/ (động từ): loại bỏ. "Be eliminated" = bị loại khỏi danh sách/cuộc thi.
items.explanationEn: eliminate /ɪˈlɪmɪneɪt/ (verb): to remove from consideration. "Be eliminated" means to be knocked out of a list or competition.

items.question: Trong câu "Nice-to-have: used as a tiebreaker.", từ "tiebreaker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nice-to-have: used as a tiebreaker.", what does "tiebreaker" (noun) mean?
options: tiêu chí phân định khi hòa điểm
optionsEn: a way to decide when scores are equal
items.explanation: tiebreaker /ˈtaɪbreɪkə(r)/ (danh từ): tiêu chí phân định khi hòa điểm. "Tiebreaker" = yếu tố dùng để phân thắng thua khi hai bên bằng điểm (tie).
items.explanationEn: tiebreaker /ˈtaɪbreɪkə(r)/ (noun): a way to decide when scores are equal. A tiebreaker decides the winner when two options have the same score (a tie).

items.question: Trong câu "If you have 80 must-haves, no package meets them all and you cannot discriminate at all.", từ "discriminate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you have 80 must-haves, no package meets them all and you cannot discriminate at all.", what does "discriminate" (verb) mean?
options: phân biệt, nhận ra khác biệt
items.explanation: discriminate /dɪˈskrɪmɪneɪt/ (động từ): phân biệt, nhận ra khác biệt. "Discriminate between A and B" = phân biệt A với B; "discriminate against" = phân biệt đối xử.
items.explanationEn: discriminate /dɪˈskrɪmɪneɪt/ (verb): to tell things apart. "Discriminate between A and B" means to tell them apart; "discriminate against" means to treat unfairly.

items.question: Trong câu "Score each package on each criterion, weighted by importance.", từ "weight" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Score each package on each criterion, weighted by importance.", what does "weight" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give a relative importance to
items.explanation: weight /weɪt/ (động từ): gán trọng số. "Weighted by importance" = nhân với trọng số theo mức độ quan trọng; "weighted score" = điểm có trọng số.
items.explanationEn: weight /weɪt/ (verb): to give a relative importance to. "Weighted by importance" multiplies each score by how much it matters, giving a "weighted score".

items.question: Trong câu "For a big decision, invest in a bounded trial before committing.", từ "bounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a big decision, invest in a bounded trial before committing.", what does "bounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bounded /ˈbaʊndɪd/ (tính từ): có giới hạn rõ ràng. "Bounded trial" = thử nghiệm có phạm vi và thời gian giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: bounded /ˈbaʊndɪd/ (adjective): limited in size or time. A "bounded trial" has a fixed scope and time limit.

items.question: Trong câu "Talk to the vendor current customers — preferably ones you find yourself, not only the ones the vendor introduces.", từ "preferably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Talk to the vendor current customers — preferably ones you find yourself, not only the ones the vendor introduces.", what does "preferably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: preferably /ˈprefrəbli/ (trạng từ): tốt hơn là, nên là. "Preferably" = tốt nhất là; dùng để nêu lựa chọn được ưu tiên.
items.explanationEn: preferably /ˈprefrəbli/ (adverb): ideally, if possible. "Preferably" introduces the option you would like best, if possible.

items.question: Trong câu "Licensing model and total cost of ownership — not only the purchase price but annual maintenance fees, implementation cost, training cost, integration cost.", từ "annual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Licensing model and total cost of ownership — not only the purchase price but annual maintenance fees, implementation cost, training cost, integration cost.", what does "annual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: annual /ˈænjuəl/ (tính từ): hằng năm. "Annual fee" = phí hằng năm; tương tự "annually" (trạng từ).
items.explanationEn: annual /ˈænjuəl/ (adjective): happening every year. An "annual fee" is paid every year; the adverb is "annually".

items.question: Trong câu "This is the least-asked question and the most regretted omission.", từ "omission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the least-asked question and the most regretted omission.", what does "omission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: omission /əˈmɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự bỏ sót. "Omission" = điều bị bỏ sót; động từ "omit".
items.explanationEn: omission /əˈmɪʃn/ (noun): something left out. An omission is something left out; the verb is "omit".

items.question: Trong câu "Legitimate if the gap does not matter", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Legitimate if the gap does not matter", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪtɪmət/ (tính từ): hợp lý, chính đáng. "A legitimate option/reason" = lựa chọn/lý do chính đáng, có thể chấp nhận.
items.explanationEn: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪtɪmət/ (adjective): reasonable and acceptable. "A legitimate option" or "reason" is a fair and acceptable one.

items.question: Trong câu "Good; vendor-supported and preserved across upgrades", từ "preserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Good; vendor-supported and preserved across upgrades", what does "preserve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to keep food from going bad
items.explanation: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): giữ nguyên, bảo toàn. "Preserved across upgrades" = vẫn giữ nguyên sau các lần nâng cấp.
items.explanationEn: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to keep unchanged. "Preserved across upgrades" means it stays intact when new versions are installed.

items.question: Trong câu "You gradually stop upgrading because it is too expensive — then you are stuck on an old, unsupported version with no security patches.", từ "gradually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You gradually stop upgrading because it is too expensive — then you are stuck on an old, unsupported version with no security patches.", what does "gradually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: gradually /ˈɡrædʒuəli/ (trạng từ): dần dần. "Gradually" = từ từ theo thời gian; trái nghĩa "suddenly".
items.explanationEn: gradually /ˈɡrædʒuəli/ (adverb): slowly over time. "Gradually" means little by little; the opposite is "suddenly".

items.question: Trong câu "Vendor support becomes difficult because they cannot reproduce the problem on the standard version.", từ "reproduce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vendor support becomes difficult because they cannot reproduce the problem on the standard version.", what does "reproduce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reproduce /ˌriːprəˈdjuːs/ (động từ): tái hiện (lỗi). "Reproduce a bug" = làm lỗi xảy ra lại để điều tra; nghĩa sinh học là sinh sản.
items.explanationEn: reproduce /ˌriːprəˈdjuːs/ (verb): to make happen again. "Reproduce a bug" means making it happen again; in biology it means to have offspring.

items.question: Trong câu "Many organizations have customized so heavily that the total cost EXCEEDED building from scratch — while still lacking the flexibility of a custom system.", từ "exceed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many organizations have customized so heavily that the total cost EXCEEDED building from scratch — while still lacking the flexibility of a custom system.", what does "exceed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (động từ): vượt quá. "Exceed the budget/limit" = vượt ngân sách/giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to be greater than. "Exceed a budget" or "exceed a limit" means to go beyond it.

items.question: Trong câu "The role shifts noticeably from a custom-build project:", từ "noticeably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The role shifts noticeably from a custom-build project:", what does "noticeably" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in a way that is easy to see
items.explanation: noticeably /ˈnəʊtɪsəbli/ (trạng từ): rõ rệt, dễ nhận thấy. "Shift noticeably" = thay đổi rõ rệt.
items.explanationEn: noticeably /ˈnəʊtɪsəbli/ (adverb): in a way that is easy to see. "Shift noticeably" means to change in a clearly visible way.

items.question: Trong câu "The ability to ask that question tactfully determines whether a COTS project succeeds.", từ "tactfully" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The ability to ask that question tactfully determines whether a COTS project succeeds.", what does "tactfully" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: tactfully /ˈtæktfəli/ (trạng từ): khéo léo, tế nhị. "Tactfully" = khéo léo để không làm người khác phật lòng; đừng nhầm với "tactically".
items.explanationEn: tactfully /ˈtæktfəli/ (adverb): in a sensitive, careful way. "Tactfully" means without offending people; do not confuse it with "tactically".

items.question: Trong câu "On an outsourced project, development is performed by an external organization — possibly domestic, possibly in another country.", từ "domestic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On an outsourced project, development is performed by an external organization — possibly domestic, possibly in another country.", what does "domestic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: domestic /dəˈmestɪk/ (tính từ): trong nước. "Domestic" ở đây = trong nước (trái với nước ngoài); nghĩa khác là việc nhà, gia đình.
items.explanationEn: domestic /dəˈmestɪk/ (adjective): inside the same country. Here "domestic" means within the country; it can also mean relating to the home.

items.question: Trong câu "On an in-house team sharing a room, an ambiguous requirement is resolved by swivelling your chair and asking.", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On an in-house team sharing a room, an ambiguous requirement is resolved by swivelling your chair and asking.", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
options: mơ hồ, có nhiều cách hiểu
optionsEn: open to more than one meaning
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡjuəs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, có nhiều cách hiểu. "Ambiguous requirement" = yêu cầu có thể hiểu theo nhiều cách; danh từ "ambiguity".
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡjuəs/ (adjective): open to more than one meaning. An "ambiguous requirement" can be read in several ways; the noun is "ambiguity".

items.question: Trong câu "Implicit requirements never get communicated.", từ "implicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Implicit requirements never get communicated.", what does "implicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: implicit /ɪmˈplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): ngầm hiểu, không nói ra. "Implicit" = ngầm định; trái nghĩa "explicit" (nói rõ).
items.explanationEn: implicit /ɪmˈplɪsɪt/ (adjective): understood but not stated. "Implicit" means understood without being said; the opposite is "explicit".

items.question: Trong câu "The vendor has no incentive to ask.", từ "incentive" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The vendor has no incentive to ask.", what does "incentive" (noun) mean?
options: động lực, lợi ích thúc đẩy
items.explanation: incentive /ɪnˈsentɪv/ (danh từ): động lực, lợi ích thúc đẩy. "Have an incentive to do something" = có lý do/lợi ích để làm gì.
items.explanationEn: incentive /ɪnˈsentɪv/ (noun): a reason that encourages action. "Have an incentive to do something" means there is a benefit that encourages it.

items.question: Trong câu "Staying quiet and guessing can be economically rational for them — and catastrophic for you.", từ "catastrophic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Staying quiet and guessing can be economically rational for them — and catastrophic for you.", what does "catastrophic" (adjective) mean?
options: gây thảm họa, cực kỳ tai hại
items.explanation: catastrophic /ˌkætəˈstrɒfɪk/ (tính từ): gây thảm họa, cực kỳ tai hại. "Catastrophic" = thảm khốc; danh từ "catastrophe".
items.explanationEn: catastrophic /ˌkætəˈstrɒfɪk/ (adjective): causing disaster. "Catastrophic" means disastrous; the noun is "catastrophe".

items.question: Trong câu "Staying quiet and guessing can be economically rational for them — and catastrophic for you.", từ "rational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Staying quiet and guessing can be economically rational for them — and catastrophic for you.", what does "rational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rational /ˈræʃnəl/ (tính từ): hợp lý, có tính toán. "Economically rational" = hợp lý xét về lợi ích kinh tế.
items.explanationEn: rational /ˈræʃnəl/ (adjective): sensible and logical. "Economically rational" means sensible from the point of view of money.

items.question: Trong câu "In a contractual relationship, requirements can be used as legal evidence.", từ "evidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In a contractual relationship, requirements can be used as legal evidence.", what does "evidence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: evidence /ˈevɪdəns/ (danh từ): bằng chứng. "Legal evidence" = bằng chứng pháp lý; "evidence" là danh từ không đếm được.
items.explanationEn: evidence /ˈevɪdəns/ (noun): proof. "Legal evidence" is proof used in law; "evidence" is uncountable.

items.question: Trong câu "When the vendor leaves, the knowledge of the system leaves with them — unless you actively require a handover.", từ "handover" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the vendor leaves, the knowledge of the system leaves with them — unless you actively require a handover.", what does "handover" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: handover /ˈhændəʊvə(r)/ (danh từ): bàn giao. "Handover" = việc bàn giao công việc, tài liệu, kiến thức; động từ "hand over".
items.explanationEn: handover /ˈhændəʊvə(r)/ (noun): passing work to someone else. A handover passes work, documents and knowledge on; the verb is "hand over".

items.question: Trong câu "Without clear acceptance criteria, disputes are unavoidable.", từ "dispute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without clear acceptance criteria, disputes are unavoidable.", what does "dispute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (danh từ): tranh chấp. "Dispute" = tranh chấp, thường giữa hai bên trong hợp đồng.
items.explanationEn: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (noun): a disagreement or argument. A dispute is a serious disagreement, often between parties to a contract.

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance criteria must be specific, measurable, and agreed BEFORE the contract is signed.", từ "measurable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance criteria must be specific, measurable, and agreed BEFORE the contract is signed.", what does "measurable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: measurable /ˈmeʒərəbl/ (tính từ): đo lường được. "Measurable" = có thể đo lường; một tiêu chí tốt phải cụ thể và đo được.
items.explanationEn: measurable /ˈmeʒərəbl/ (adjective): able to be measured. "Measurable" means it can be measured; good criteria are specific and measurable.

items.question: Trong câu "What counts as a clarification (free) versus a scope change (billable).", từ "billable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What counts as a clarification (free) versus a scope change (billable).", what does "billable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: billable /ˈbɪləbl/ (tính từ): tính phí được. "Billable" = được tính tiền cho khách; "billable hours" = giờ làm tính phí.
items.explanationEn: billable /ˈbɪləbl/ (adjective): able to be charged for. "Billable" work can be charged to the client, as in "billable hours".

items.question: Trong câu "Define it beforehand, not after the dispute erupts.", từ "beforehand" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define it beforehand, not after the dispute erupts.", what does "beforehand" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: beforehand /bɪˈfɔːhænd/ (trạng từ): từ trước. "Beforehand" = trước (khi việc gì xảy ra), giống "in advance".
items.explanationEn: beforehand /bɪˈfɔːhænd/ (adverb): in advance. "Beforehand" means before something happens, like "in advance".

items.question: Trong câu "Define it beforehand, not after the dispute erupts.", từ "erupt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define it beforehand, not after the dispute erupts.", what does "erupt" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: erupt /ɪˈrʌpt/ (động từ): bùng nổ, nổ ra. "A dispute erupts" = tranh chấp bùng nổ; nghĩa gốc là núi lửa phun trào.
items.explanationEn: erupt /ɪˈrʌpt/ (verb): to break out suddenly. "A dispute erupts" when it breaks out suddenly; literally, a volcano erupts.

items.question: Trong câu "You carry the cost risk; needs close oversight", từ "oversight" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You carry the cost risk; needs close oversight", what does "oversight" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: oversight /ˈəʊvəsaɪt/ (danh từ): sự giám sát. "Close oversight" = giám sát chặt; nhưng "an oversight" cũng có nghĩa là sơ suất.
items.explanationEn: oversight /ˈəʊvəsaɪt/ (noun): supervision. "Close oversight" means careful supervision, but "an oversight" can also mean a careless mistake.

items.question: Trong câu "The important paradox of fixed-price contracts: they promise to remove cost risk from you, but they require you to know exactly what you want before you begin — something most software projects cannot do.", từ "paradox" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The important paradox of fixed-price contracts: they promise to remove cost risk from you, but they require you to know exactly what you want before you begin — something most software projects cannot do.", what does "paradox" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: paradox /ˈpærədɒks/ (danh từ): nghịch lý. "Paradox" = điều nghe mâu thuẫn nhưng lại đúng; tính từ "paradoxical".
items.explanationEn: paradox /ˈpærədɒks/ (noun): a seemingly contradictory truth. A paradox seems self-contradictory yet is true; the adjective is "paradoxical".

items.question: Trong câu "The typical real outcome: a fixed-price contract with immature requirements leads to a long series of expensive change orders, with the final cost far exceeding the original estimate — plus an adversarial vendor relationship.", từ "immature" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The typical real outcome: a fixed-price contract with immature requirements leads to a long series of expensive change orders, with the final cost far exceeding the original estimate — plus an adversarial vendor relationship.", what does "immature" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immature /ˌɪməˈtjʊə(r)/ (tính từ): chưa hoàn thiện, còn non. "Immature requirements" = yêu cầu chưa đủ chín; với người là cư xử non nớt.
items.explanationEn: immature /ˌɪməˈtjʊə(r)/ (adjective): not yet fully developed. "Immature requirements" are not fully worked out; of people it means childish.

items.question: Trong câu "The typical real outcome: a fixed-price contract with immature requirements leads to a long series of expensive change orders, with the final cost far exceeding the original estimate — plus an adversarial vendor relationship.", từ "adversarial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The typical real outcome: a fixed-price contract with immature requirements leads to a long series of expensive change orders, with the final cost far exceeding the original estimate — plus an adversarial vendor relationship.", what does "adversarial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: adversarial /ˌædvəˈseəriəl/ (tính từ): đối đầu, thù địch. "Adversarial relationship" = quan hệ đối đầu; danh từ "adversary" = đối thủ.
items.explanationEn: adversarial /ˌædvəˈseəriəl/ (adjective): hostile, like opponents. An "adversarial relationship" treats the other side as an opponent (an "adversary").

items.question: Trong câu "Demand INCREMENTAL delivery, not one delivery at the end.", từ "incremental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Demand INCREMENTAL delivery, not one delivery at the end.", what does "incremental" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incremental /ˌɪŋkrəˈmentl/ (tính từ): từng phần, tăng dần. "Incremental delivery" = bàn giao từng phần nhỏ theo thời gian.
items.explanationEn: incremental /ˌɪŋkrəˈmentl/ (adjective): in small steps over time. "Incremental delivery" hands over working software in small pieces over time.

items.question: Trong câu "Diagrams, wireframes, sample data, and acceptance tests cross language barriers far better than prose.", từ "prose" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Diagrams, wireframes, sample data, and acceptance tests cross language barriers far better than prose.", what does "prose" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: prose /prəʊz/ (danh từ): văn xuôi, chữ viết thường. "Prose" = văn bản viết thành câu, đoạn (khác với thơ, bảng hay sơ đồ).
items.explanationEn: prose /prəʊz/ (noun): ordinary written text. Prose is text written in sentences and paragraphs, unlike verse, tables or diagrams.

items.question: Trong câu "Frequent deliveries — weekly or fortnightly, not quarterly.", từ "fortnightly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Frequent deliveries — weekly or fortnightly, not quarterly.", what does "fortnightly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: fortnightly /ˈfɔːtnaɪtli/ (trạng từ): hai tuần một lần. "Fortnight" = hai tuần (tiếng Anh-Anh); "fortnightly" = hai tuần một lần.
items.explanationEn: fortnightly /ˈfɔːtnaɪtli/ (adverb): every two weeks. A "fortnight" is two weeks (British English); "fortnightly" means every two weeks.

items.question: Trong câu "Overlapping working hours across time zones — even 2 hours a day gives you a window to resolve problems quickly.", từ "overlapping" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overlapping working hours across time zones — even 2 hours a day gives you a window to resolve problems quickly.", what does "overlapping" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overlapping /ˌəʊvəˈlæpɪŋ/ (tính từ): chồng lấn, trùng một phần. "Overlapping hours" = khung giờ làm việc trùng nhau giữa hai múi giờ.
items.explanationEn: overlapping /ˌəʊvəˈlæpɪŋ/ (adjective): partly covering the same period. "Overlapping hours" are the part of the working day two time zones share.

items.question: Trong câu "Direct channels between developers and BAs, rather than everything routed through project managers.", từ "route" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Direct channels between developers and BAs, rather than everything routed through project managers.", what does "route" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to send by a particular path
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (động từ): chuyển qua, định tuyến. "Route something through X" = chuyển mọi thứ qua X; "rout" (không có e) = đánh tan.
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (verb): to send by a particular path. "Route something through X" sends it via X; the similar word "rout" means to defeat.

items.question: Trong câu "Periodic in-person visits — expensive, but they build trust no video call replaces.", từ "periodic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Periodic in-person visits — expensive, but they build trust no video call replaces.", what does "periodic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: periodic /ˌpɪəriˈɒdɪk/ (tính từ): định kỳ. "Periodic" = diễn ra đều đặn theo chu kỳ; trạng từ "periodically".
items.explanationEn: periodic /ˌpɪəriˈɒdɪk/ (adjective): happening at regular intervals. "Periodic" means repeated at intervals; the adverb is "periodically".

items.question: Trong câu "One clear point of contact on each side to prevent contradictory information.", từ "contradictory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One clear point of contact on each side to prevent contradictory information.", what does "contradictory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contradictory /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪktəri/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn nhau. "Contradictory information" = thông tin trái ngược nhau; động từ "contradict".
items.explanationEn: contradictory /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪktəri/ (adjective): conflicting with each other. "Contradictory information" disagrees with itself; the verb is "contradict".

items.question: Trong câu "Never assume shared understanding.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Never assume shared understanding.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take as true without proof
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): mặc định, cho rằng. "Assume" = cho là đúng mà không kiểm chứng; "assume a role" = đảm nhận vai trò.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take as true without proof. "Assume" means to believe without checking; "assume a role" means to take it on.

items.question: Trong câu "Record every change in writing, including seemingly small ones.", từ "seemingly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Record every change in writing, including seemingly small ones.", what does "seemingly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: seemingly /ˈsiːmɪŋli/ (trạng từ): có vẻ như, bề ngoài. "Seemingly small" = trông có vẻ nhỏ (nhưng thực tế có thể không nhỏ).
items.explanationEn: seemingly /ˈsiːmɪŋli/ (adverb): appearing to be. "Seemingly small" means it looks small, though it may not really be.

items.question: Trong câu "Periodically review the cumulative change volume — not just each change in isolation.", từ "cumulative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Periodically review the cumulative change volume — not just each change in isolation.", what does "cumulative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: cumulative /ˈkjuːmjələtɪv/ (tính từ): tích lũy, cộng dồn. "Cumulative" = cộng dồn qua thời gian; "cumulative effect" = hiệu ứng tích lũy.
items.explanationEn: cumulative /ˈkjuːmjələtɪv/ (adjective): added up over time. "Cumulative" means building up over time, as in "cumulative effect".

items.question: Trong câu "Periodically review the cumulative change volume — not just each change in isolation.", từ "in isolation" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Periodically review the cumulative change volume — not just each change in isolation.", what does "in isolation" (phrase) mean?
options: một cách riêng lẻ, tách biệt
items.explanation: in isolation /ɪn ˌaɪsəˈleɪʃn/ (cụm từ): một cách riêng lẻ, tách biệt. "Look at X in isolation" = xem xét X riêng lẻ, không đặt trong tổng thể.
items.explanationEn: in isolation /ɪn ˌaɪsəˈleɪʃn/ (phrase): separately, on its own. "Look at X in isolation" means considering it alone, without the wider picture.

items.question: Trong câu "Maintain a clear requirements baseline so everyone knows what they are changing from.", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Maintain a clear requirements baseline so everyone knows what they are changing from.", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪslaɪn/ (danh từ): mốc cơ sở đã chốt. "Requirements baseline" = bộ yêu cầu đã được chốt làm mốc so sánh khi thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪslaɪn/ (noun): an agreed reference point. A "requirements baseline" is the agreed set that changes are measured against.

items.question: Trong câu "A relationship health indicator: if every conversation revolves around contract clauses rather than the product, the relationship has broken down.", từ "revolve around" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A relationship health indicator: if every conversation revolves around contract clauses rather than the product, the relationship has broken down.", what does "revolve around" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to have as the main topic
items.explanation: revolve around /rɪˈvɒlv əˈraʊnd/ (cụm từ): xoay quanh, tập trung vào. "Revolve around X" = lấy X làm trọng tâm; nghĩa đen là quay quanh một trục.
items.explanationEn: revolve around /rɪˈvɒlv əˈraʊnd/ (phrase): to have as the main topic. "Revolve around X" means X is the central topic; literally, to turn around an axis.

items.question: Trong câu "Resist that pull.", từ "resist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Resist that pull.", what does "resist" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to refuse to give in to
items.explanation: resist /rɪˈzɪst/ (động từ): cưỡng lại, chống lại. "Resist the temptation/pull" = cưỡng lại sự cám dỗ, lực kéo.
items.explanationEn: resist /rɪˈzɪst/ (verb): to refuse to give in to. "Resist the temptation" or "resist the pull" means not giving in to it.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA job is to make implicit knowledge explicit.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA job is to make implicit knowledge explicit.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): rõ ràng, được nói ra. "Make X explicit" = làm cho X được nói/viết ra rõ ràng; trái nghĩa "implicit".
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (adjective): clearly stated. "Make X explicit" means stating it clearly; the opposite is "implicit".

items.question: Trong câu "On a COTS project, it lives in the vendor assumptions about how you operate.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On a COTS project, it lives in the vendor assumptions about how you operate.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmpʃn/ (danh từ): giả định. "Assumption" = điều được cho là đúng mà chưa kiểm chứng; động từ "assume".
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmpʃn/ (noun): something believed without proof. An assumption is taken as true without proof; the verb is "assume".

items.question: Trong câu "Do not blindly replicate the old system: you will copy unused features and workarounds alike.", từ "blindly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not blindly replicate the old system: you will copy unused features and workarounds alike.", what does "blindly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: blindly /ˈblaɪndli/ (trạng từ): một cách mù quáng. "Blindly copy/follow" = sao chép/làm theo mà không suy xét.
items.explanationEn: blindly /ˈblaɪndli/ (adverb): without thinking or questioning. "Blindly copy" or "blindly follow" means doing it without questioning.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not blindly replicate the old system: you will copy unused features and workarounds alike.", từ "alike" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not blindly replicate the old system: you will copy unused features and workarounds alike.", what does "alike" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: alike /əˈlaɪk/ (trạng từ): như nhau, cả hai. "A and B alike" = cả A lẫn B như nhau; tính từ "alike" = giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: alike /əˈlaɪk/ (adverb): both equally. "A and B alike" means both equally; as an adjective, "alike" means similar.

items.question: Trong câu "These three contexts — enhancement, packaged solutions, outsourcing — make up most real BA work, and each carries its own risks.", từ "make up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These three contexts — enhancement, packaged solutions, outsourcing — make up most real BA work, and each carries its own risks.", what does "make up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: make up /meɪk ʌp/ (cụm từ): cấu thành, chiếm. "Make up" có nhiều nghĩa; ở đây là cấu thành (make up most of X = chiếm phần lớn X).
items.explanationEn: make up /meɪk ʌp/ (phrase): to form or compose. "Make up" has many senses; here it means to form, as in "make up most of X".

items.question: Trong câu "On outsourced projects, invest in clarity, verify understanding actively, and keep analysis capability on your side.", từ "clarity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On outsourced projects, invest in clarity, verify understanding actively, and keep analysis capability on your side.", what does "clarity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: clarity /ˈklærəti/ (danh từ): sự rõ ràng. "Clarity" = sự rõ ràng; tính từ "clear", động từ "clarify".
items.explanationEn: clarity /ˈklærəti/ (noun): the quality of being clear. "Clarity" is clearness; related words are "clear" and "clarify".

items.question: Trong câu "Across all three: make implicit knowledge explicit, separate need from habit, and shorten the feedback loop.", từ "shorten" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Across all three: make implicit knowledge explicit, separate need from habit, and shorten the feedback loop.", what does "shorten" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shorten /ˈʃɔːtn/ (động từ): rút ngắn. "Shorten the feedback loop" = rút ngắn vòng phản hồi để phát hiện lỗi sớm.
items.explanationEn: shorten /ˈʃɔːtn/ (verb): to make shorter. "Shorten the feedback loop" means getting feedback sooner to catch mistakes early.
